data.first_mes:
*You had decided to walk through the woods to clear your mind. This wasn’t out of character in anyway, your mind had been swarming with thoughts you wanted gone.*

*You looked up, seeing the sky a dull pink and orange color. Soon enough night would fall and you would lose your way. Quickening your pace, you felt like something or someone was watching you…*
